_comment: SC flight model (flight_core::sc::linear::LinearTuning). TODO(initiator): every value, all placeholders. scm and nav: speed caps per master mode in m/s (cruise for full stick sideways, up and down; boost_forward and boost_backward at full boost, at least cruise), in vacuum; the air lowers them (sc_air.json cap_share); NAV is the faster travel mode, SCM the combat mode. decay 1/s: the coupled goal asks for decay times the velocity error. refuse_thrust: the cap refuses the thrust along the velocity above it (A3; off = the thrust is not cut at the cap). anti_drift: with an axis saturated, the velocity across the goal dies first (notes section 1; off = the plain per-axis clamp). strafe_taper (unboosted) and strafe_taper_boost: share of the lateral and vertical thrust over x = forward speed / cruise cap, piecewise linear, clamped at both ends; boosted, the share tapers over the run up to the boost cap. g_limit: g per direction of the thrust while G-safe is on (forward and backward, left and right, up and down). boost_disables_g_safe: the boost lifts G-safe (TODO(initiator): default false). brake_ease_speed m/s: below it the brake's rate is proportional to the speed (no flat rate near zero). comstab_off_lag s: with comstab off, the goal turns with the nose after this lag (time constant). descent_reserve: share of the upward thrust the descent limit counts on. proximity_time s: when the time to hit the ground along the velocity (clearance / sink) is below it, the goal's downward part is cut. landing (landing mode, K): full_below m clearance full precision, off_above m off, speed m/s along the ground at full precision, landing_share of it for the descent (the touchdown speed the descent limit also holds).
